blocks.text: The Guru next instructs Banda on how to build the campaign: honor every Sikh who joins him, call especially for the Majha Sikhs, and remember that grace and power already flow through the Khalsa body.
In this telling the Majha Sikhs are not auxiliary but central, because their arrival turns Banda’s personal commission into a collective Khalsa undertaking.
The page closes with written orders, names, and mobilization, showing the movement hardening into a real network rather than remaining a private blessing.
